review.rationale: For these exact schema vNext2 source bytes, Ajv 8.20.0 produces byte-identical strict true/false validator functions (SHA256 1df2dfde37492dfceb76f10a33e9aaae96c98b94ade7784de9a4e949e3fb287f). Independent review compared decisions and errors on 10556 schema-boundary and seeded JSON values (seed146148). All keywords/types are known and there are no numeric type validators whose strictNumbers behavior differs. Any source or Ajv change requires renewed review.

With previous matching the parsed source and concrete YAML sequences, starting at length plus one performs two extra absent-index deletions. YAML 2.9.0 YAMLSeq.delete uses items.splice(index, 1); both extra deletions are no-ops, followed by the original descending deletions. The separate equality guard preserving untouched aliases remains enforced by its regression test.
